scope: Bounded regional optional catalog milestone covering 18 measured models across five kits and five ecological roles, palette/category/group/item controls, exact foliage edits with surrounding-world preservation, physical scale and collision proxies, staged publication, history/session restoration, distant-chunk ownership and retirement, plus the existing book/vase publication regression. This review does not approve catalog-expansion, full catalog breadth, arbitrary placement, physical-phone performance, total decoded/GPU budgeting, or release adoption.

intuitiveness.evidence: The regional controls expose category, role group and exact model choices, defer world mutation until Apply, and give clear foliage-only scope feedback. The retained phone capture shows the selected model, Apply to selection and the surrounding selection tools in a usable 390x844 layout. Undo/Redo, saved-session restoration, retirement and reacquisition are exercised through the actual controls.

accuracy.evidence: The 18 admissions pin source and manifest identities, measured triangles/vertices/texture pixels, conservative transformed envelopes and role metadata. Worker validation enforces regional role and single-instance placement, while the renderer uses the admitted physical scale, grounds and centers each model, verifies decoded bounds, retains all optional foliage profiles through distant chunk streaming, and retires derived templates before raw leases. Retained native and browser evidence covers exact unaffected-layer preservation, collision clearance, complete residency accounting, session/history recovery, cancellation regression, and zero browser/console/model-resource diagnostics.

wowFactor.evidence: The final renders provide a broad, coherent ecological set: contrasting canopy trees, shrubs, flowering forms, crops and rocks appear with recognizable silhouettes and grounded contact on the terrain. Group captures and individual close views show the replacement models after the gray-source cleanup, while the full overview and phone controls demonstrate that the feature remains integrated with the existing world editor.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The milestone combines source-level semantic admission with physical placement envelopes, conservative tree circles and quarter-turn rock rectangles, deterministic jitter, layer-preserving edits, complete-world profile pinning and camera-driven detailed chunk construction. The same transaction and residency machinery supports regional terrain foliage alongside the earlier interior objects, including retirement and later Undo reacquisition.

nonBlockingFindings: This is a bounded 18-model regional admission and publication result. Resident geometry counters represent distinct admitted profiles rather than every placed instance or total decoded/GPU allocation; browser-internal buffers and physical-device performance are outside the evidence. Full catalog breadth, additional roles and release-level playability remain open, so catalog-expansion stays review:null. Overview captures naturally make distant foliage small; close captures provide the appropriate visual quality evidence.
